method: official U.S. diplomatic chronology cross-checked against Wheaton and Princeton mission-family archives; vivid rescue details remain bounded to their exact archival family

important_deltas.finding: FRUS 1934 provides an independent official chronology family for the capture, death reports and fate of the child.
Wheaton and Princeton remain the primary families for the mission and family-detail layer rather than being treated as duplicates of the diplomatic record.
Sleeping bag, exact money, milk and rice-basket details are not described as independently confirmed by FRUS unless an exact diplomatic document says so.
The role of local Chinese Christians is retained as part of the historical action after the missionaries' deaths, not as a decorative footnote.

unsupported_popular_claims.claim: Every vivid rescue detail in later Stam biographies is independently confirmed by U.S. diplomatic records.
The child's survival proves a general promise of earthly protection for faithful missionaries.
